name: Sei Shugo Senshi Liatris
original_name: 聖守護戦士リアトリス
source:
Main character is tired of protecting the world, and he starts to feel emptiness. But then Liatris appears who also fights all by herself without asking for gratitude. She knows the answer to the most important questions - who she is and what she fights for.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公已经厌倦守护世界，心中也开始感到空虚。就在此时，圣守护战士莉亚特莉丝出现在他面前。她同样孤身奋战，从不奢求任何人的感激；她也清楚自己究竟是谁，明白自己为何而战。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
